notes: This profile is the fail-closed R100B adoption gate for the low-band production wave solver only.
Geometric-reference and hybrid-overlap fixtures remain separate later-role evidence and are not silently treated as passed by this profile.
Candidate probe_capabilities are permission to evaluate a fixture, not proof that the required capability has passed.
R100A-3 makes explicit radiation termination a distinct required wave capability; omitting it cannot remove the termination fixture from selection.
Changing this adoption profile does not rewrite historical R100B run hashes; selected decisions bind the exact profile hash.
